text_block_list.text:
After fighting a fierce battle alongside 
Mejiro Ardan in the Nippon Derby, Sakura 
Chiyono O is hospitalized due to injury 
and temporarily sidelined from racing...

Vowing to meet again on the turf one day, 
Mejiro Ardan wishes to become someone 
worthy of standing as her rival.

There were two possible futures that
could be presented as her next goal.
One was the 
Kikuka Sho—the final leg of the Triple 
Crown, offering a rematch against Yaeno 
Muteki.

And the other is the supreme 
intermediate-distance race, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn),
where the strongest senior-class 
contenders gather,
led by Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

Whichever path she chooses, a fierce 
battle awaits Mejiro Ardan,
along with the 
growth it will bring. As her Trainer, the 
choice is—
Target race changed to Kikuka Sho.

Her path forward has been set for the 
Kikuka Sho. With renewed resolve,
she vows 
to push forward toward her next battle...!
Target race changed to Tenno Sho (Autumn).

Her path forward has been set for the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). With renewed resolve, 
she vows to push forward toward her next 
battle...!
